It is indeed possible to swap a voltage regulator on a Fiat Premio before the HOA president takes his 7A morning walk. More to follow in Episode 16. 

- Caleb, reporting from HBI's Carioca Desk

After taking it all apart and putting it all back together I discovered I had accidentally tightened the automatic tensioner, and the timing belt squealed like a supercharger! Sooooo, I had to take it all back apart once again and fix it....ugh. But, it's done! Fresh timing belt!
-Justin

It's a late night at the HBI Production Desk here in our Rio Bureau, but Episode 15: It's a Saab Story, Doncha Know is edited and ready for transmission: Thursday @ 11P Eastern/Friday @ Midnight Brasilia Time. 

Doncha miss it.

-Caleb
